name: HOSON-Robot
summary: HOSON-Robot is a wheeled humanoid developed by HOSON’s wholly owned robotics subsidiary. It combines an anthropomorphic upper body and articulated arms with motion control, dexterous-hand and joint modules developed by the company. The platform is intended for loading, unloading and assembly in semiconductor and electronics environments. It was publicly launched in October 2025; a June 2026 issuer response reported that the business remained in research and development without production orders at the end of the first quarter.
